parties.respondent: Waseem, Nazim, Aslam, Abubakar and Another

summary: Criminal appeals against High Court bail grants to accused in multiple cases; charges include murder, attempt to murder, rioting under IPC s.302, 307, 147, 148, 34; bail orders upheld in HC despite cancellation of co-accused's bail; trial evidence includes eyewitness accounts; bail rescinded on parity grounds; orders set aside for inconsistent reasoning.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court bail orders quashed; accused remand maintained pending trial.
